items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: that is where I met Joe Williams, the singer.

ctx.x: How did you actually get to Buffalo?

Well… Actually I'm trying to remember exactly how that happened. I know I worked for about six months. No – I worked for about four of five months in Cleveland at this place called Cedar Gardens. By the way, that is where I met Joe Williams, the singer. He was working at a place called the Sky Lounge in another part of town and I want to hear him one night. That is where I met Joe Williams.
Anyway, I went to Buffalo, I think I got a call from George Clark. I wanted to leave Cedar Gardens anyway because that job was – –

items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: Hank Jones, Jimmy Jones, Osie Johnson, Milt Hinton, Kenny Burrell, oh boy, Romeo Penque, Harold Lookofsky.

ctx.x: Harry “Sweets” Edison, and I like that Bohanon, the trombonist you worked with, and so many of them. I mean I love them. Jimmy Jones and everyone.
Yup, yup, yup, yup, yup. Hank Jones, Jimmy Jones, Osie Johnson, Milt Hinton, Kenny Burrell, oh boy, Romeo Penque, Harold Lookofsky. Really all these wonderful — Zoot Sims, Frank Foster, and —
And the Jones-Lewis band. The Thad Jones-Mel Lewis band.
